groups.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker
groups.description: Circuit breaker configuration for Core Banking security.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.cleanup-initial-delay-minutes
properties.description: Initial delay in minutes before first cleanup run.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.cleanup-period-minutes
properties.description: Interval in minutes between cleanup runs.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.cleanup-time-budget-ms
properties.description: Maximum time in milliseconds allowed for each cleanup run.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.max-dynamic-breakers
properties.description: Maximum number of dynamic circuit breakers allowed.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.shutdown-timeout-seconds
properties.description: Timeout in seconds for graceful shutdown of the cleanup executor.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.failure-rate-threshold
properties.description: Failure rate threshold percentage that triggers OPEN state.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.wait-duration-in-open-state
properties.description: Duration to wait before transitioning from OPEN to HALF_OPEN.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.sliding-window-size
properties.description: Size of the sliding window used to aggregate metrics.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.minimum-number-of-calls
properties.description: Minimum number of calls required before calculating failure rate.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.permitted-number-of-calls-in-half-open-state
properties.description: Number of calls allowed in HALF_OPEN state.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.slow-call-rate-threshold
properties.description: Slow call rate threshold that triggers OPEN state.

properties.name: frisboo.security.circuitbreaker.max-wait-duration-in-half-open-state
properties.description: Maximum wait time in HALF_OPEN state.
